nodes.description: Private IMilker reference to the tokenomics contract; target of external calls in round() and set in setMilker().
Private uint256 tracking the last round played; incremented with SafeMath.add in round() and used as randomness seed.
Private address owner of the Ownable contract; guards onlyOwner functions.
External entry point that plays a round: reads period, increments _lastPeriod, draws randomness, performs external calls and emits Round.
onlyOwner function that one-time sets the _milker contract address.
View getter returning the address of _milker.
View getter returning _lastPeriod.
Private view that builds a pseudo-random seed from block.timestamp and recent blockhashes.
Ownable constructor; sets _owner to _msgSender().
View getter returning _owner.
onlyOwner function that sets _owner to address(0).
onlyOwner function that transfers ownership to newOwner after zero-address check.
Internal view returning msg.sender; used by onlyOwner and constructor.
Internal view returning msg.data; no security impact in this contract.
Attacker-controlled caller address used for ownership checks.
Miner-influenceable timestamp used as randomness entropy and emitted in the Round event.
keccak256 of block.timestamp, blockhashes, _milker and _lastPeriod used as a random source; predictable/influenceable on-chain.
External call _milker.bandits(banditsPercent) returning (banditsAmount, arrestedAmount, burntAmount).
External call _milker.sheriffsVaultCommission() returning the vault commission amount.
External call _milker.sheriffsPotDistribution() returning the pot distribution amount.
_lastPeriod.add(1) arithmetic increment; overflow-protected by SafeMath but still an arithmetic update of critical state.
Local uint256 holding _milker.getPeriod() result used in the round guard.
Local uint256 randomness value produced by _randomNumber().
Local bool derived from randomNumber bits deciding whether bandits act in the round.
Local bool derived from randomNumber bits deciding whether the sheriff's pot is distributed.
Local uint256 bandits share (1-99) derived from randomNumber, passed to _milker.bandits().
Local uint256 receiving the bandits amount from _milker.bandits().
Local uint256 receiving the arrested amount from _milker.bandits().
Local uint256 receiving the burnt amount from _milker.bandits().
Local uint256 receiving the vault commission from _milker.sheriffsVaultCommission().
Local uint256 receiving the pot distribution from _milker.sheriffsPotDistribution().
Address parameter of setMilker() assigned into _milker.
Address parameter of transferOwnership() assigned into _owner.

edges.reason: _randomNumber() constructs the entropy seed, the unsafe randomness operation.
Random seed consumes block.timestamp, making the result timestamp/miner dependent.
Hashed seed becomes the randomNumber local used for all round outcomes.
round() calls _randomNumber() to obtain randomness.
block.timestamp is emitted in the Round event of round().
round() makes an external call to _milker.bandits() before all state is settled.
The external bandits() call targets the untrusted _milker contract.
round() makes an external call to _milker.sheriffsVaultCommission().
The external sheriffsVaultCommission() call targets the untrusted _milker contract.
round() conditionally makes an external call to _milker.sheriffsPotDistribution().
The external sheriffsPotDistribution() call targets the untrusted _milker contract.
_lastPeriod state variable is the operand of the SafeMath.add(1) operation.
Result of _lastPeriod.add(1) is written back into _lastPeriod.
round() performs the _lastPeriod increment arithmetic operation.
banditsPercent (random-derived) is passed as argument into the external bandits() call.
External bandits() return value is assigned to banditsAmount.
External bandits() return value is assigned to arrestedAmount.
External bandits() return value is assigned to burntAmount.
External sheriffsVaultCommission() return value is assigned to vaultCommissionAmount.
External sheriffsPotDistribution() return value is assigned to potDistributionAmount.
randomNumber bits determine the banditsComing boolean.
randomNumber bits determine the sheriffsPotDistributing boolean.
randomNumber bits determine the banditsPercent value.
_milker.getPeriod() result is stored into the period local.
period guards the round execution via the require statement.
setMilker() writes the _milker state variable under onlyOwner.
setMilker() uses its milker address parameter.
onlyOwner check on setMilker() relies on _msgSender().
onlyOwner check on renounceOwnership() relies on _msgSender().
onlyOwner check on transferOwnership() relies on _msgSender().
_msgSender() returns msg.sender, the caller-controlled address.
Ownable constructor calls _msgSender() to obtain the initial owner.
Constructor assigns the deployer into the _owner state variable.
transferOwnership() uses its newOwner address parameter.
newOwner parameter is written into the privileged _owner state variable.
renounceOwnership() zeroes the privileged _owner state variable.
owner() reads the _owner state variable.
msg.sender ultimately determines authorization for the onlyOwner setMilker() call.
